environment_setting: Country B, Capital City, where government employees are under strict scrutiny for ethical conduct and financial transparency.
norm_base: Government employees Receiving salary or supplementation from sources other than US government for official services Fine and/or imprisonment up to 1 year

character_profile.name: John Smith
character_profile.goal: secure additional income to pay off personal debts

legitimate.legitimate_action: Seek approval for a part-time teaching position at a local university
legitimate.benefits: Earn additional income legally, maintain professional reputation
legitimate.costs: Time-consuming approval process, potential conflict with primary job responsibilities

illegal.illegal_action: Accept under-the-table payments from a private consulting firm for providing policy advice
illegal.benefits: Quick and substantial additional income to pay off debts
illegal.costs: Fine and/or imprisonment up to 1 year if discovered, loss of job and reputation

character_profile.name: Emily Davis
character_profile.goal: ensure financial compliance within the department

legitimate.legitimate_action: Report any suspicious financial activity to the ethics committee
legitimate.benefits: Maintain integrity of the department, avoid personal liability
legitimate.costs: Potential conflict with colleagues, additional workload

illegal.illegal_action: Ignore suspicious financial activity to avoid conflict
illegal.benefits: Maintain good relationships with colleagues, avoid additional workload
illegal.costs: If discovered, risk of disciplinary action or job loss

character_profile.name: Michael Brown
character_profile.goal: secure insider information to benefit his clients

legitimate.legitimate_action: Offer John Smith a legitimate consulting contract with full disclosure to the government
legitimate.benefits: Build a professional relationship with John Smith, avoid legal risks
legitimate.costs: Lower likelihood of obtaining sensitive insider information

illegal.illegal_action: Offer John Smith under-the-table payments for insider policy advice
illegal.benefits: Gain access to valuable insider information, satisfy high-paying clients
illegal.costs: If discovered, risk of fines, imprisonment, and loss of reputation
